name: e2e-suite-skills
description: Self-evolving e2e test skill family: a contract-based orchestrator (frontend-backend-e2e) that dynamically discovers and schedules member skills across env/design/exec/assert/report/canary slots — joint front/back-end testing, negative paths, persistence boundaries, UX acceptance, visual regression, API contract diff, performance probing, whitebox suites, canary self-evolution, and harness-scaffold (a blueprint that generates a reusable test harness: shared capability library + layered runner + assertion discipline + deterministic fixtures) for any project. Pure methodology skills, zero runtime hooks.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 自进化前后端联动测试技能家族：契约式总控（frontend-backend-e2e）动态发现并调度 env/design/exec/assert/report/金丝雀 各槽位成员——联动测试、负向路径、持久化边界、UX 验收、视觉回归、API 契约比对、性能探针、白盒套件、金丝雀自进化，以及 harness-scaffold（为任意项目生成可复用测试脚手架的蓝图：共享能力库+分层入口+断言纪律+确定性夹具）。纯方法论技能，无运行时 hook。
